description: Long dark navy wool kaftan/coat over an ivory linen long shirt, with fine pale geometric embroidery at neckline, front opening, cuffs, shoulder seams and hem. Narrow brown fur trims collar and cuffs. Paired round metal chest clasps and a woven decorated belt with round buckle and tasselled hanging end. Brown trousers and tall wrapped brown leather boots. No headgear, armor or weapons.
